pe_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, phone rear-camera candid capture with natural light, vertical framing, 35mm look, inside the Lingxiao Palace as established in <Picture 1>: the Jade Emperor seated on the golden dragon throne on the raised dais, the elder in a brown hooded robe bowing deeply at right foreground with fists clasped at his chest, and the weasel standing upright on hind legs at left foreground. From 0 to 3 seconds, a medium shot favors the elder with a slight low angle so the Emperor remains visible above; the elder's bow holds near ninety degrees, fists pressed to his chest with thumbs over fingers, cloth shoes shifting faintly on the stone floor. The aged, hoarse, slow-speaking elder (S1) says with clear enunciation and pauses between phrases: <d>[Chinese] 陛下……小神有本启奏。</d> The Emperor leans slightly forward from his upright seat, right hand settling on his knee, gaze turning down toward the elder. From 3 to 6 seconds, the camera holds a static shot framing all three subjects — the elder front and soft, the Emperor mid-frame in sharp focus, the weasel rear and half-soft. The elder (S1) continues: <d>[Chinese] 那黄皮子……已随小神前来领罪。</d> his clasped fists bobbing gently with his words as his bow eases from about ninety degrees to about sixty. The weasel stays motionless while its head slowly droops, gaze sliding down toward its own shoulder where a few unruly hairs stand out against the smooth coat; the Emperor's fingers tap the armrest two or three faint times. From 6 to 10 seconds, the elder closes his mouth, lowers his hands to his sides, and slowly straightens while keeping a slight forward lean; the Emperor settles back against the throne, right hand lifting from knee to armrest, both hands resting flat. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow, motorized speed, focus racking from the elder's face to the weasel, ending on a medium-close of the weasel still staring down at the messy tuft of fur on its shoulder, its faint breathing audible as incense smoke drifts through the silence.

overall_soundscape: Cloth shoes shift faintly against the stone floor while the elder's robe rustles as his fists bob and his bow eases. Subtle knuckle clicks come from his clasped hands, a soft fur-rustle sounds as the weasel lowers its head, two or three faint finger taps land on the throne armrest, and near the end the hall falls quiet except for the weasel's faint breathing and the soft friction of the Emperor's dragon robe against the chair.
